title: Triangular Fuzzy Rescaling Distance
abstract: arXiv:2608.19234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision-making in complex systems often involves dealing with imprecise or uncertain information, frequently represented using fuzzy sets, particularly Triangular Fuzzy Numbers (TFNs). A crucial aspect of many fuzzy methods is the quantification of distance between TFNs. Many distance measures assume that all values are in the same scale, requiring a preliminary normalization stage when applied to heterogeneous attributes with different scales or units. This paper proposes the Triangular Fuzzy Rescaling Distance (d_{TR}), a metric designed to address this challenge. The d_{TR} uniquely integrates Linear Rescaling (LRE) directly into the distance calculation, ensuring normalization during the comparison of fuzzy numbers. We formally prove that d_{TR} satisfies the properties of a metric, including non-negativity, identity, symmetry, and the triangle inequality. tldr: 本文提出了一种新的三角模糊数距离度量d_{TR}，它通过将线性重缩放直接集成到距离计算中，实现了无需预归一化的尺度不变性，并严格证明了其满足度量性质。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel distance metric d_{TR} for triangular fuzzy numbers that integrates linear rescaling directly into the distance calculation, achieving scale invariance without pre-normalization, and formally proves its metric properties.
